page: Amazon Web Services r8gd.12xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by custom 64-bit ARMv9 AWS Graviton Neoverse-V2 processors. It features 48 dedicated physical cores operating at 2.8 GHz with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, backed by 384.0 GB of system memory, which yields 8.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance includes 2850 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 22 Gbps under the AWS Nitro hypervisor.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier memory performance, with large-block read and write memory bandwidths placing in the top 10% of tested systems. Multi-core compute capabilities are strong, as evidenced by top-tier results in Geekbench multi-core testing and software compilation. Database operations and static web serving throughput also rank in the top 10%, while Redis SET operations and medium-model LLM text generation demonstrate strong performance.

The combination of high-density ARM64 cores, a large memory footprint, and high-speed local NVMe SSD storage provides high resource density and qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads. This hardware profile is well-suited for high-throughput database operations, in-memory caching systems like Redis, software compilation pipelines, and static web serving at scale.
